messages.author: 1bf3bb84a245eefc
messages.subject: Can someone please resolve the brew::brew issue, for R sake?
parts:
Hi All,

Sorry for being a pest but it would be awesome if someone can help me
resolve this issue of brew::
This directive in apache configuration fails, no matter what I do -
apache just hangs for ever, remove the directive and all works fine
except .rhtml files or .R files with <%= ... %>

<Directory /var/www/brew>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

I have spend more time trying to resolve brew::brew than the time I
spend in building and compiling, Ubuntu, R and Apache

I have brew directory in all of these folders plu
"/usr/local/lib/R/site-library" "/usr/lib/R/site-library" "/usr/lib/R/
library"

I also have brew folder in my root directory
/var/www/brew

In all the above locations there is a brew.R file in the brew
directory. I have downloaded the brew from Cran few times already
without much success.

I have also tried the following in the configuration file without any
success

<Directory /var/www/brew>
<FilesMatch "\.(brew|r|R|rhtml)$">
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</FilesMatch>
</Directory>

and the this

RFileHandler \var\www\brew\brew.R::brew

uname -a command give the following if it is any help (its 32 bit
hardware)
Linux linux 2.6.35-22-generic-pae #33-Ubuntu SMP Sun Sep 19 22:14:14
UTC 2010 i686 GNU/Linux

I have already read through hundreds of posts on Rapache group, and
read the manual few times from first page to the last. I am not a
dummy but this is really killing me. Please help.

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Can someone please resolve the brew::brew issue, for R sake?
parts:
Did you catch the posts I sent today regarding the possibility that
you may have two R's installed? Please check your RApacheInfo page.

Regardless, I think you have a few misunderstandings:

1. Only packages are allowed under *folders*
/usr/local/lib/R/site-library, /usr/lib/R/site-library, and
/usr/lib/R/library. So don't place brew.R files or any other files
there.

2. You install packages by calling either install.packages() with the
appropriate arguments (see ?install.packages), OR you can install
source packages that you download by calling "R CMD INSTALL
package_you_just_untarred". To get help with that, call "R CMD INSTALL
-h".

Best,

Jeff

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Can someone please resolve the brew::brew issue, for R sake?
parts:
Okay, that's good.

Now have you set this directive in on
/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/default (or whatever name the default site
is named, maybe 000default or some such)?

If your DocumentRoot is /var/www, then any brewed file will have the URL of:

http://localhost/brew/somefile

Do you have files located in /var/www/brew? What's their permissions?
Can www-data read them?

What are the last few lines in your /var/log/apache2/errors.log file
after trying to browse one of your brew files?

Jeff

and re-started the apache and all worked. Now I see brew under
